# Bundled source

These snapshots come from public forks of Uncle Bob Martin's tools. Each tool keeps its upstream license and tests. Each fork adds `--base` so the gates check commits as well as local edits. The files here match the linked fork commits. To update, change the fork, then copy its `src/` here.

| Tool | Source commit |
| --- | --- |
| crapper | [talibilat/crapper at db7918f](https://github.com/talibilat/crapper/tree/db7918fc981bd818794ece51703eeb59abf62d00) |
| mutator | [talibilat/mutator at 36a4dd4](https://github.com/talibilat/mutator/tree/36a4dd44feb4fae125605fdb708bff889a79a8d9) |
